Name: Londyn’s Duet
Components: V, S, M (a metal coin with two identical sides)
Description:
You create a translucent duplicate of yourself, which shares your personality, which appears within 5 feet of you, or the nearest unoccupied space. You can use it to perform a duet or a two-person comedy routine together, or to support you and your allies in combat. The duplicate looks exactly like you, and has your equipment. You can determine the appearance of its clothing, but its face must be visible. The duplicate knows all the japes, songs that you do, and shares proficiencies with musical instruments that you possess. While the duplicate is within 30 feet of you, you have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks you make, and the duplicate accompanies and harmonizes with you. The duplicate has the following traits:
● AC equals 11 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
● It is immune to the charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, and restrained conditions.
● It is immune to opportunity attacks and psychic damage.
● If it is forced to make a saving throw, it uses your proficiency bonus and adds your spellcasting ability modifier to the roll.
● It speaks and understands the languages you do, and while it is within 1 mile of you, the two of you can communicate telepathically.
● If the duplicate takes damage, you take half that amount as psychic damage.
● It cannot interact with objects other than its possessions created by the spell.
● It cannot make ability checks or cast spells. As a bonus action, you can command the duplicate to do one of the following:
● Attack. Move up to 30 feet and make one weapon attack. The weapon must have been on your person when you cast the spell and gains no benefits from being magical. Make a melee or ranged spell attack that matches the weapon's properties. On a hit, it deals force damage equal to the weapon's damage die + your spellcasting ability modifier.
● Inspire. Expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration, granting the inspiration die to a creature within 60 feet of the duplicate that can hear it.
● Defend. Take the Dodge action, or move up to 60 feet. If your duplicate travels more than 1 mile away from you, the spell ends.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage of its weapon attacks increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd. If you use a spell slot of 3rd level, the duration increases to 1 hour. If you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration increases to 8 hours.
